response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced Staff/Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years of full-stack experience, far exceeding the junior/mid-level scope of this role. While technical skills (TypeScript, React, Node.js, databases) strongly overlap with requirements, the seniority mismatch raises concerns about salary expectations, role satisfaction, and retention, and there's no direct PostgreSQL or Nest.js experience mentioned.
strengths: Extensive full-stack development experience across web, backend, and infrastructure
Strong TypeScript/React/Node.js proficiency directly matching core stack requirements
Demonstrated software craftsmanship (TDD, CI/CD, clean architecture) aligning with 'clean architecture' interest requirement
concerns: Significantly overqualified for an entry-level/junior-mid role, risking quick disengagement or turnover
No explicit PostgreSQL or Nest.js experience listed (mostly MongoDB, DynamoDB-adjacent AWS tools)
No indication of interest in relocating career trajectory downward or willingness to accept junior-level compensation/scope
